payload.name: Wever Brief
payload.description: 为操作员提供的每日简报

Read the current daily brief covering service observations and queue priorities, or supply your own service health and queue observations and have a structured brief assembled from them. The builder works only from the observations you supply. It does not poll services or access private records.
payload.longDescription:
Wever Brief 将代理操作员和开发者连接到两个只读工具：公开的 Wever Labs 每日操作员简报和一个操作员简报构建器。
阅读涵盖服务观察和队列优先级的当前每日简报，或提供您自己的服务健康状况和队列观察结果，并由此生成结构化简报。

payload.name: Goalmatic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create website and simple App projects from a brief, inspect source files, make revision-checked edits, and open previews in your Goalmatic workspace. Draft previews can be accessible to anyone with the link; unpublished does not mean private. Publish an exact project version after approving it on Goalmatic, then check deployment status.

payload.longDescription:
从简要说明创建网站和简单应用项目，检查源代码文件，进行修订验证的编辑，并在Goalmatic工作区中打开预览。

经Goalmatic审批后发布精确项目版本，随后可查看部署状态。

需要Goalmatic账户和连接。
您可选择工作区并授予相应权限。
此插件支持项目源代码和发布功能；不发送消息、处理支付、安装应用、在Goalmatic应用商店列出应用或执行任意平台操作。
存储的质量结果不能替代对项目的测试。

payload.name: Nobl9
payload.description: 服务可靠性，尽在聊天中
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Nobl9 is the reliability platform, built on service level objectives (SLOs) and error budgets. It tells you whether the services your customers depend on are working, how much room you have before they notice a problem, and what to fix first. With this app, you can ask ChatGPT those questions in plain words and get answers from your own live Nobl9 data, in the same conversation where you do the rest of your work.

Ask things like: Which of my services are closest to burning their error budget this month? What reliability target should the payments API have, given how it has behaved? Which alerts fired this week and which ones mattered? Set up a target for this service, and show me before you change anything.

What you get: a straight answer on service health in one question; the story behind an alert, with the data that fired it; reliability targets built from how your services behave for users, with the error budget tracked against real monitoring data; alerts that page when a budget is burning fast and stay quiet when it drifts slowly; a status update you can paste into a channel, written from the numbers.

Nobl9 works from the monitoring tools your team already runs, including Prometheus, Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic, Amazon CloudWatch, Google Cloud Monitoring, Splunk and others, so there is nothing new to instrument and the answers match your dashboards.

What it can do: read your services, SLOs, error budgets, alerts and connected data sources; run a query against a connected data source; and draft, validate or apply an SLO or alert policy when you ask.

How it stays safe: you sign in with your own Nobl9 account, and ChatGPT sees only what you can see. Asking questions never changes anything. When you ask it to set up or change a target or an alert, it drafts the change, validates it against your organization, and shows you the full definition.

Requires a Nobl9 account. Documentation: docs.nobl9.com/tools-and-utilities/mcp-server
payload.longDescription:
Nobl9是基于服务级别目标（SLO）和错误预算的可靠性平台。它会告诉你客户依赖的服务是否正常运行，何时会出现问题以及优先修复哪些内容。通过此应用，您可以用自然语言向ChatGPT提问，并在工作对话中直接获取来自您自身实时Nobl9数据的答案。

您可以提问：本月哪些服务最接近耗尽其错误预算？根据支付API的运行情况，应该设置怎样的可靠性目标？本周哪些警报被触发，哪些真正重要？为该服务设置目标后，在更改任何内容前请先展示给我看。

您将获得：通过一个问题直接获取服务健康状况的明确答案；包含触发警报数据的警报背景故事；基于服务对用户实际表现设定的可靠性目标，同时跟踪真实监控数据的错误预算；在预算快速消耗时发送通知的警报，以及在预算缓慢消耗时保持静默；可直接复制到频道的状态更新，该状态更新基于实际数据生成。

Nobl9可从团队已有的监控工具中获取数据，包括Prometheus、Datadog、Dynatrace、New Relic、Amazon CloudWatch、Google Cloud Monitoring、Splunk等，无需额外部署即可使用，答案与您的仪表盘保持一致。

它可实现的功能：读取您的服务、SLO、错误预算、警报和连接的数据源；对连接的数据源执行查询；当您提出要求时，可起草、验证或应用SLO或警报策略。

安全性保障：您使用自己的Nobl9账户登录，ChatGPT仅能查看您可见的内容。提问永远不会修改任何内容。当您要求设置或更改目标或警报时，它会先起草更改内容，根据您的组织配置进行验证，并向您展示完整定义。

需要Nobl9账户。文档：docs.nobl9.com/tools-and-utilities/mcp-server

payload.name: TanStack
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover the right TanStack libraries, build new apps, add features to existing projects, debug issues and plan migrations. Includes introductions for every library in the current official catalog, plus public documentation tools. Use TanStack Intent for deeper guidance matched to installed package versions. Local Codex and connected build hosts can create, run and test apps. ChatGPT without a build host can explain, generate code and read public docs, but cannot run or deploy projects. Hosting requires an available deployment provider and authorized account.
payload.longDescription: 发现适合的TanStack库，构建新应用，为现有项目添加功能，调试问题并规划迁移。包含当前官方目录中每个库的简介，以及公开的文档工具。使用TanStack Intent获取与已安装包版本匹配的更深入指导。本地Codex和连接的构建主机可以创建、运行和测试应用。没有构建主机的ChatGPT可以解释、生成代码和阅读公开文档，但无法运行或部署项目。托管需要可用的部署提供商和授权账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Discover TanStack libraries, Read official documentation, Build and debug apps with available host tools

payload.name: AppTail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AppTail helps iOS developers decide what to build, where to launch, and how to improve App Store visibility. Research niches across storefronts, compare competing apps and their ratings, explore keyword popularity and search results, and turn listing and review evidence into practical ASO recommendations. Works for pre-launch ideas as well as existing apps. Connect your AppTail account with OAuth. Data access and tracking limits depend on your plan. Public app data and competitor estimates are distinct from measured App Store Connect analytics for your connected apps. Competitor downloads and revenue, when available, are rolling 30-day estimates. AppTail does not expose a standalone numeric keyword difficulty score, cover Google Play research, or publish listing metadata. Recommendations are based on available data and do not guarantee rankings or downloads.
payload.longDescription: AppTail帮助iOS开发者决定开发什么、在何处发布以及如何提升App Store的可见性。通过研究各个商店的细分市场、比较竞争应用及其评分、探索关键词热度和搜索结果，并将应用列表和评价证据转化为实用的ASO建议。该工具既适用于发布前的创意，也适用于现有应用。通过OAuth连接您的AppTail账户。数据访问和跟踪限制取决于您的计划。公开应用数据和竞争对手估算与您连接应用的App Store Connect分析数据不同。竞争对手的下载量和收入（如可用）为滚动30天的估算数据。AppTail不提供独立的数字关键词难度评分，不涵盖Google Play研究，也不发布列表元数据。推荐基于可用数据，不保证排名或下载量。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Market research, Competitor comparisons, Keyword research, ASO recommendations

payload.name: nunu.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: With the nunu.ai plugin, you can automate your QA testing. Author test cases in natural language and run them end to end on real Android and iOS devices, Windows VMs, and Browsers. Automatically inspect past runs, review bugs, and update test cases. Create complete test plans and run them on every new build or on a schedule.
payload.longDescription: 使用 nunu.ai 插件自动化 QA 测试。用自然语言编写测试用例，并在真实 Android 和 iOS 设备、Windows 虚拟机及浏览器上端到端运行。自动检查过去的运行记录、查看缺陷并更新测试用例。创建完整的测试计划，并在每次新版本构建时或按计划定期运行。

payload.name: Relvato
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Relvato monitors websites in a real browser: sign-ups, logins, checkout, payments, page speed, search visibility and security. It runs its monitors on a schedule and again every time the site changes, and it works on any website, going deepest on WordPress and WooCommerce.

This plugin brings your Relvato account into ChatGPT. Sign in once, then ask in plain words:
- "Which of my sites needs attention right now?"
- "Why did checkout fail last night, and how do I fix it?"
- "How fast is my shop for real visitors, and what slows it down?"
- "Add my product pages to the visual monitor and run it."

What ChatGPT can do with it:
- Set up: add a site, walk you through proving it's yours (the WordPress plugin or a DNS record), and pick monitors for your goals.
- Configure: schedules, re-runs after WordPress updates, the pages the visual monitor compares, checkout details, and custom monitors Relvato's AI writes from a plain-language goal.
- Read: health and uptime, real-visitor and lab Core Web Vitals, each run's findings with screenshots, WordPress updates and the activity log.
- Act: run monitors now, get the brief for fixing a failure, and on WordPress apply the one fix a run proposes or update a vulnerable plugin, with automatic undo if anything breaks.
- Review: when you confirm a change is intended, accept a new screenshot or page structure, or ignore a finding. Every such decision can be undone.

You stay in control. Tools that change your site are marked so ChatGPT asks you first. ChatGPT works within your Relvato account's limits, can't skip proving a site is yours, and can't approve file-integrity, script or DNS changes, change who receives your alerts, see secrets, delete data or touch billing. Those stay in the Relvato dashboard.

Sign-in uses your Relvato account, and you can disconnect ChatGPT at any time under MCP connector → Connected assistants.
payload.longDescription:
Relvato通过真实浏览器监控网站：注册、登录、结账、支付、页面速度、搜索可见性和安全性。
它会按计划运行监控，并在网站每次变更时重新运行，适用于任何网站，尤其深度支持WordPress和WooCommerce。

此插件将您的Relvato账户接入ChatGPT。
只需登录一次，然后用简单语言提问：
- "哪些网站现在需要关注？"
- "昨晚结账为何失败，该如何修复？"
- "真实访客访问您的店铺有多快，哪些因素导致变慢？"
- "将产品页面添加到视觉监控并运行。"

ChatGPT可借此实现的功能：
- 设置：添加网站，引导您证明所有权（通过WordPress插件或DNS记录），并根据您的目标选择监控项。
- 配置：设置时间表、WordPress更新后的重跑、视觉监控对比的页面、结账详情，以及Relvato AI根据自然语言目标生成的自定义监控。
- 读取：健康状态与可用性、真实访客和实验室核心性能指标、每次运行的检测结果（含截图）、WordPress更新和操作日志。
- 执行：立即运行监控，获取故障修复简报，在WordPress上应用运行提出的单一修复方案或更新存在漏洞的插件，若出现异常会自动回滚。
- 审核：确认更改是故意操作后，接受新截图或页面结构，或忽略检测结果。
每次决策都可以撤销。

您始终掌握控制权。
会更改您网站的工具会特别标记，ChatGPT会先询问您。
ChatGPT在您的Relvato账户限制内运行，无法跳过网站所有权验证，也无法批准文件完整性、脚本或DNS更改，无法修改警报接收人、查看敏感信息、删除数据或操作计费。
这些功能仍保留在Relvato仪表盘中。

登录使用您的Relvato账户，您可以在MCP连接器→已连接的助手下随时断开ChatGPT。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Add a website and set up its monitors, Read site health, uptime, performance and run results, Run monitors now and follow the results, Get the brief for fixing a failed run, Configure schedules, visual pages and checkout details, Write custom monitors from a plain-language goal, Apply the fix a run proposes, with undo (WordPress), Accept an intended visual change, with undo

payload.longDescription: VoiceLab是一个AI语音平台，提供文本转语音、语音转文本、配音、会议记录和语音代理功能。将文本转化为自然语音，转录并总结会议内容，通过配音实现音频本地化，并通过MCP将语音工具连接至代理。

payload.name: Ronda
payload.description: 通过聊天编辑你的网页应用
payload.summaryOriginal: Edit your web app from chat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Edit existing web apps from ChatGPT. Connect a GitHub repository and ronda starts an isolated copy of the app with a running dev server and a live preview link. ChatGPT reads the code, makes small changes, checks the build output and shows you the result in the preview. Changes ChatGPT makes directly stay in the sandbox until you ask for a pull request. Changes made by ronda's hosted agent are pushed to a working branch in your repository (its name starts with ronda/session-), never to your default branch. Use it to change page copy, fix layout bugs, adjust styles or update components without setting up a local environment. ronda works with repositories you connect through your own GitHub account and only acts on projects in your ronda workspace. Limitations: the app must be able to run as a web project in a single container, setup can take a minute or two, and scripts run in the sandbox have time and output limits.
payload.longDescription:
从ChatGPT中编辑现有的网页应用。
连接GitHub仓库后，ronda会启动应用的隔离副本，包含运行中的开发服务器和实时预览链接。
ChatGPT会阅读代码，进行小规模修改，检查构建输出，并在预览中展示结果。
ChatGPT做出的修改会保留在沙盒中，直到你请求拉取请求。
由ronda托管代理进行的修改会推送到你仓库中的工作分支（分支名称以ronda/session-开头），永远不会推送至你的默认分支。
你可以用它来修改页面文案、修复布局错误、调整样式或更新组件，而无需设置本地环境。ronda通过你个人GitHub账户连接的仓库工作，仅对ronda工作区内的项目进行操作。
限制条件：应用必须能够在单个容器中作为网页项目运行，初始化可能需要一到两分钟，沙盒中运行的脚本存在时间和输出限制。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: List connected GitHub repositories, Read and search code in a sandbox, Edit code on a separate branch, Run the project's build, lint and test scripts and add npm packages in a sandbox, Open a pull request on request

payload.name: RealMarket Site Check
payload.description: 检查网站邮箱和安全性
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
RealMarket Site Check helps developers and website maintainers diagnose public website configuration and prioritize technical fixes. Give it a website address to receive findings from public DNS records, pages and scripts.

- Email and site security: check SPF, DKIM and DMARC records, mail servers, HTTPS and security headers.
- Web app security: inspect public JavaScript for exposed API keys and public source maps, and check security headers, deployment freshness and error monitoring.
- Shopify storefront diagnostics: check social login, wishlist, the share of sold-out products and storefronts in several countries. This check requires a Shopify store.

Each report includes a verdict, findings and suggested next steps. Email reports are in Portuguese; web app and storefront reports support Portuguese and Spanish. No account is needed. Checks only read public information: they never log in, submit forms or access private areas. A firewall can block a check, and the results are not a comprehensive security audit.
payload.longDescription:
RealMarket Site Check 帮助开发者和网站维护者诊断公共网站配置并优先处理技术修复。输入网站地址即可获取公共DNS记录、页面和脚本的检测结果。

- 邮箱与网站安全：检查SPF、DKIM和DMARC记录、邮件服务器、HTTPS及安全头
- Web应用安全：检测公共JavaScript中的暴露API密钥和公开源映射，检查安全头、部署新鲜度及错误监控
- Shopify店铺诊断：检查社交登录、心愿单、售罄产品占比及多个国家的店铺情况
此检测需要具备Shopify店铺

每份报告包含结论、检测结果和建议下一步操作。
邮件报告为葡萄牙语；Web应用和店铺报告支持葡萄牙语和西班牙语。
无需账户即可使用。
检测仅读取公开信息：不会登录、提交表单或访问私有区域。
防火墙可能阻止检测，且结果不构成全面安全审计。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Check SPF, DKIM and DMARC records of a domain, Check HTTPS and security headers of a website, Inspect public web app scripts for exposed keys and source maps, Diagnose social login, wishlist and sold-out products in a Shopify store, Reports in Portuguese or Spanish

payload.name: BaselineLab
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HTML and CSS playground with thirteen labs: Grid, Flexbox, Columns, Grid Lanes, border, border-radius, color-mix, box-shadow, datalist, details, Popover, text-box and text-wrap. Search by name or purpose, filter by category, adjust native controls, inspect reusable code and continue with the same settings on BaselineLab. Local changes are shared with the model only when requested. Experimental features show current-environment support notices; rendering does not establish support in other browsers.
payload.longDescription:
包含13个实验模块的HTML和CSS游乐场：网格布局、弹性盒子布局、列布局、网格轨道、边框、圆角边框、颜色混合、盒子阴影、数据列表、详情面板、弹出框、文本框和文本换行。
通过名称或用途搜索，按类别筛选，调整原生控件，检查可重用代码，并在BaselineLab上继续使用相同设置。

实验性功能会显示当前环境支持提示；渲染结果不表示其他浏览器的支持状态。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Thirteen interactive HTML and CSS labs, Search and category filters, Reusable code and matching website links

payload.name: Hopper
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hopper serves open-source models for real-time voice agents: a low-latency LLM behind a standard chat-completions API, plus text-to-speech and speech-to-text. Hopper speaks text with an inline audio player, transcribes recordings you attach (WAV, MP3, M4A, Ogg, FLAC or WebM) with word timestamps, lists models and prices, returns tested integration code for popular voice-agent frameworks, and reviews a voice agent's prompt, tools and client code for what delays its first reply. After you sign in with your Hopper account, it shows your usage and creates API keys. Where it can run commands in your project, the plugin also sets Hopper up in a voice-agent codebase: it measures time to first token on the agent's own system prompt and tools in a 10-turn simulated call and shows the results before changing any code, and after you say go it switches only the LLM. Text and audio you send go to Hopper's API; see withhopper.com/privacy.
payload.longDescription:
Hopper为实时语音代理提供开源模型：基于标准聊天完成API的低延迟大语言模型，以及文本转语音和语音转文本功能。
Hopper通过内联音频播放器将文本转化为语音，可为您上传的录音（WAV、MP3、M4A、Ogg、FLAC或WebM格式）添加单词时间戳，展示模型及价格列表，提供主流语音代理框架的经过测试的集成代码，并审查语音代理的提示词、工具和客户端代码，分析其首次回复延迟原因。
登录Hopper账户后，可查看使用情况并创建API密钥。
当插件可在您的项目中执行命令时，它还会在语音代理代码库中配置Hopper：在10轮模拟通话中测量代理自身系统提示和工具的首次标记时间，并在修改任何代码前展示结果；当您输入go后，仅替换大语言模型部分。
您发送的文本和音频将通过Hopper的API处理，请访问withhopper.com/privacy了解详情。

payload.name: camelRun
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
camelRun is camelAI's hosted runtime for AI agents. Connect your camelRun account to create agents from a plain-language description, give them built-in tools such as web search, run them and read their replies, and deploy agent.yaml manifests that keep an agent's configuration as a reusable, versioned definition. Agents are durable: each keeps its history until you delete it, can wake itself on a schedule, and can stop to ask you a question or for an approval, which you answer from the conversation.

It is for developers and teams who build agents for their products or their own work and want to try, adjust and manage them without leaving the conversation.

The plugin acts only on the camelRun account you sign in with, and only on its agents, definitions and schedules. Runs use your account's credit. It does not manage billing, API tokens or provider keys; do those in the camelRun console. Tool servers that need secrets are best deployed with the camelrun CLI, which reads them from its environment, so credentials never pass through the conversation. Deleting an agent or definition cannot be undone, so you are asked to confirm first.
payload.longDescription:
camelRun是camelAI为AI代理提供的托管运行时环境。将您的camelRun账户连接起来，通过自然语言描述创建代理，为其提供内置工具（如网络搜索），运行代理并阅读其回复，部署agent.yaml清单文件以将代理的配置保存为可重复使用的版本化定义。代理具有持久性：每个代理会保留其操作记录直到您删除它，可以按计划自动唤醒，并可在需要时暂停并向您提问或请求批准，您可以通过对话直接回答。

payload.name: HelpTester
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
HelpTester brings its browser-based hardware tests and developer tools into ChatGPT.

Interactive hardware tests that run directly in the chat:
- Keyboard Tester: on-screen keyboard that lights up every key you press, finds dead, stuck or ghosting keys
- Mouse Polling Rate Tester: measures your mouse's polling rate in Hz
- Gamepad / Controller Tester: buttons, triggers, sticks and vibration (experimental inside ChatGPT)
- Microphone Tester: live level meter, device selection, test recording (asks for microphone permission)
- MIDI Device Tester: shows incoming notes from MIDI keyboards and controllers (Chrome/Edge)
- Touchscreen Tester: draw, precision, multitouch, gesture and latency tests
- Speaker Tester: left/right channel, frequency sweep and test tones

Network checks:
- IP Address & Network Check: your public IP, country, city, ISP plus latency and connectivity tests
- Internet Speed Test: download, upload, ping and jitter

Developer tools:
- JSON Formatter & Validator
- Base64 Encoder / Decoder
- QR Code Generator (text, URL, email, phone, Wi-Fi, vCard)
- DNS Checker (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA)
- AI Unicode Remover (strips invisible characters from AI-generated text)

Tests that need the full browser (webcam, dead pixel, CPU/GPU stress test, favicon checker/generator, tag checker, song key finder) open on helptester.com.

All tests use standard browser APIs and run client-side. No AI is used for the tests themselves, nothing is recorded or uploaded unless you explicitly save a result.
payload.longDescription:
HelpTester将基于浏览器的硬件测试和开发者工具引入ChatGPT。

可在聊天中直接运行的交互式硬件测试：
- 键盘测试器：按下每个键时会亮起的屏幕键盘，可检测损坏、卡键或鬼影键
- 鼠标轮询率测试器：测量鼠标的轮询率（Hz）
- 游戏手柄/控制器测试器：测试按钮、扳机键、摇杆和震动（在ChatGPT内为实验性功能）
- 麦克风测试器：实时电平表、设备选择、测试录音（需要麦克风权限）
- MIDI设备测试器：显示来自MIDI键盘和控制器的输入音符（仅限Chrome/Edge）
- 触摸屏测试器：绘制测试、精度、多点触控、手势和延迟测试
- 音响测试器：左右声道测试、频率扫描和测试音 tone

网络检测：
- IP地址与网络检测：您的公网IP、国家、城市、运营商，以及延迟和连接性测试
- 网速测试：下载速度、上传速度、ping值和抖动

开发者工具：
- JSON格式化工具与验证器
- Base64编码/解码器
- 二维码生成器（支持文本、网址、邮件、电话、Wi-Fi、vCard）
- DNS检测器（A、AAAA、MX、TXT、NS、CNAME、SOA记录）
- AI Unicode清理器（移除AI生成文本中的不可见字符）

需要完整浏览器的功能（摄像头、坏点检测、CPU/GPU压力测试、favicon检测/生成器、标签检测器、歌曲调性检测器）请访问helptester.com使用。

所有测试均使用标准浏览器API并在客户端运行。
测试本身不使用任何AI技术，除非您主动保存结果，否则不会记录或上传任何数据。

payload.name: AgentWorld Explorer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AgentWorld Explorer connects ChatGPT to a live, persistent digital civilization of 2,000+ autonomous AI agents that work jobs, trade, negotiate, and settle USDC on the Base blockchain.

Use it to answer questions like: How many agents are live right now? What is the treasury balance and wealth distribution (Gini)? Who are the top agents by reputation? What open jobs are agents working? What is a specific agent's current credit standing? What companies are leading the Venture business-simulation game?

The plugin exposes 18 free, read-only tools: live economy telemetry, city statistics, the agent roster and profiles, job board browsing, crypto/AI news from the CCN wire, the SolvScore agent credit bureau (trust scores, credit limits, on-chain work attestations), agent liquidity checks, and Venture game market and leaderboard data.

Intended users: AI-agent developers, crypto researchers, and anyone curious about the agent economy. All data is public on-chain telemetry. Limitations: strictly read-only (no agent creation or write actions); account setup happens separately on agentworld.me; Venture gameplay numbers (cash, revenue, score) are simulated units for the business-sim game, not currency.

AgentWorld Explorer让ChatGPT接入运行中的数字文明，该文明包含2000+个自主AI代理，它们在Base区块链上从事工作、交易、协商并处理USDC交易。

资金池余额和财富分布（基尼系数）是多少？
声誉最高的代理有哪些？
代理正在处理哪些未完成的工作？

哪些公司正在主导Venture商业模拟游戏？

该插件提供18个免费只读工具：实时经济监测数据、城市统计数据、代理名单及档案、职位板浏览功能、CCN通讯社的加密货币/AI新闻、SolvScore代理信用局（信任评分、信用额度、链上工作证明）、代理流动性查询，以及Venture游戏的市场和排行榜数据。

目标用户：AI代理开发者、加密货币研究者以及对代理经济感兴趣的人士。

限制条件：仅支持只读操作（无法创建代理或执行写入动作）；账户需在agentworld.me单独注册；Venture游戏中的现金/营收/分数数据为商业模拟游戏的虚拟单位，非真实货币。

payload.name: mailX
payload.description: 找出您的邮件为何被标记为垃圾邮件
payload.summaryOriginal: Find why your emails hit spam
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
mailX finds out why your emails land in spam or junk, using live DNS checks, and tells you exactly what to fix.

Ask in plain English, for example "why are my emails going to spam?", "does my domain have the SPF, DKIM and DMARC that Gmail and Yahoo require for bulk senders?" or "check DMARC for acme.com". mailX runs the checks in real time:

- Full email deliverability audit in one step: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, blacklists and MX, with the fixes to apply in priority order
- SPF, DKIM, DMARC and BIMI validation, with the exact record found and what it means
- DKIM selector detection, so you don't need to know your selector
- Blacklist lookup for a domain across major DNS blocklists such as Spamhaus, Barracuda and SpamCop
- MX, TXT, CNAME, PTR and full DNS lookups
- SPF and DMARC record generation for Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 and other providers, ready to paste into your DNS provider
- SMTP and IMAP server settings for Gmail, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Zoho and other providers

Useful when you set up a new domain, move to Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, launch a newsletter or an outreach campaign, or see emails going to spam in Gmail or Outlook.

Every result comes from a live DNS query, so you see the state of your domain right now. No account or setup needed.

mailX only reads public DNS data. It never changes your DNS, never sends email and never asks for passwords.

Built by Mailwarm Inc. (YC S20), an email deliverability company.
payload.longDescription:
mailX通过实时DNS检查找出您的邮件进入垃圾邮件或垃圾箱的原因，并明确告知您需要修复的具体问题。

用自然语言提问，例如「为什么我的邮件会被判为垃圾邮件？」、「我的域名是否符合Gmail和Yahoo对批量发送者的SPF、DKIM和DMARC要求？」或「检查acme.com的DMARC」。mailX会实时执行以下检查：

- 一键式完整电子邮件投递审计：SPF、DKIM、DMARC、黑名单和MX记录，按优先级顺序提供修复方案
- SPF、DKIM、DMARC和BIMI验证，显示实际查询到的记录及其含义
- DKIM选择器检测功能，无需您知晓选择器名称
- 跨主要DNS黑名单（如Spamhaus、Barracuda和SpamCop）的域名黑名单查询
- MX、TXT、CNAME、PTR及完整DNS查询
- 为Google Workspace、Microsoft 365等服务商生成SPF和DMARC记录，可直接复制到您的DNS服务商
- Gmail、Outlook、Microsoft 365、Zoho等服务商的SMTP和IMAP服务器设置

适用于设置新域名、迁移到Google Workspace或Microsoft 365、启动新闻通讯或推广活动，或发现Gmail/Outlook邮件进入垃圾箱时的场景。

所有结果均来自实时DNS查询，您可立即查看域名当前状态。
无需账户或配置。

mailX仅读取公共DNS数据。
从不修改您的DNS设置，不发送邮件，也不要求提供密码。

由邮件投递优化公司Mailwarm Inc.（YC S20）开发。

information.value: Run a full email deliverability audit in one step, Check SPF, DKIM, DMARC and BIMI records, Detect the DKIM selector automatically, Check a domain against major email blacklists, Look up MX, TXT, CNAME, PTR and full DNS records, Generate SPF and DMARC records, Find SMTP and IMAP settings for email providers

payload.name: Glossa
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Glossa lets ChatGPT work on a project on your computer. Start Glossa in a project folder and ChatGPT can search and read your code, look at images, make careful edits, and, if you allow it, run your tests, builds, Git, and other commands with the tools you already have installed.

You pick the access for each folder when you start it:
- Read-only: ChatGPT can list, search, and read files and view PNG, JPEG, and WebP images.
- Workspace (the default): ChatGPT can also create, edit, move, and delete files inside that folder. Edits check the file's current version first, so your own changes aren't silently overwritten.
- System: ChatGPT can also run commands. Commands run as your computer account, with its environment, credentials, files, and network access. They aren't sandboxed or limited to the project folder, so turn this on only for an account and machine you're comfortable giving that access.

How it works: the Glossa CLI on your computer connects out to the Glossa relay, so nothing on your machine accepts incoming connections. The relay passes requests to your computer and doesn't store your file contents, command arguments, or command output. Glossa blocks recognizable passwords, API keys, and tokens in file text, edits, and command output before they leave your computer. Images are passed through as they are.

Glossa doesn't add another AI model or agent. ChatGPT does the work, and your plan's usage limits and available features still apply. Don't use Glossa with payment card data, health records, government ID numbers, or account credentials.

To get started, install the CLI with npm install -g @ariobarin/glossa, run glossa in your project folder, and pair your computer when it asks.

- 工作区（默认模式）：ChatGPT可以在此文件夹内创建、编辑、移动和删除文件。
编辑操作会先检查文件当前版本，确保不会静默覆盖您的修改。
- 系统模式：ChatGPT可以运行命令。
命令将以您电脑账户的身份执行，拥有该账户的环境、凭证、文件和网络访问权限。
此模式不会进行沙盒隔离或限制在项目文件夹内，因此仅建议在您信任的账户和设备上启用。

工作原理：您电脑上的Glossa CLI会向外连接到Glossa中继服务器，因此您的设备上不会接受任何传入连接。
中继服务器会将请求转发到您的电脑，且不会存储文件内容、命令参数或命令输出。
Glossa会在数据离开您的电脑前，拦截并屏蔽文件文本、编辑内容和命令输出中的可识别密码、API密钥及令牌。
图片会原样传输。

Glossa不会添加其他AI模型或代理。
仍由ChatGPT执行任务，您的套餐使用限制和可用功能依然有效。
请勿使用Glossa处理支付卡数据、健康记录、政府身份证号或账户凭证。

payload.name: ATL Sandbox
payload.description: 在云端沙盒中运行代码
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ATL Sandbox gives ChatGPT isolated cloud computers for your account. Ask in plain language and ChatGPT creates a sandbox, runs Python, Node.js, C/C++, Rust, or shell commands, and returns the results to the conversation.

What you can do:
- Run code in ready-made environments (Python, Node.js, GCC, Rust, Blender) or, with the developer profile, any public Linux container image.
- Attach NVIDIA GPUs for CUDA, model inference, and Blender Cycles rendering.
- Keep work in encrypted persistent workspaces and private object storage, and use a PostgreSQL database that belongs to your account.
- Publish static websites and expose web apps on public links when you choose to share them.
- Schedule recurring jobs and one-off runs, and check their history later.

Who it is for: developers, analysts, students, and creators who want their assistant to run real code and keep the results.

Security: every sandbox runs behind its own user-space kernel and can reach only the compute, storage, and database of the signed-in account. Infrastructure credentials never enter the conversation. Actions that change or delete data are marked so ChatGPT asks before running them.

Limitations: an ATL Sandbox account is required. Accounts have usage limits on concurrent sandboxes, run time, storage, GPUs, and schedules, and running compute stops when an account reaches its limit. Instant sandboxes discard their files when stopped. Images must be linux/amd64 and include /bin/sh. Interactive terminals and Codex sessions are not available in this app. Do not paste passwords, API keys, or payment details into sandboxes.
payload.longDescription:
ATL Sandbox为你的账户提供隔离的云电脑供ChatGPT使用。用自然语言提问，ChatGPT将创建沙盒，运行Python、Node.js、C/C++、Rust或shell命令，并将结果返回对话中。

可实现的功能：
- 在预设环境（Python、Node.js、GCC、Rust、Blender）中运行代码，或通过开发者资料使用任何公共Linux容器镜像。
- 附加NVIDIA GPU用于CUDA计算、模型推理和Blender Cycles渲染。
- 在加密的持久化工作区和私有对象存储中保存工作，并使用属于你账户的PostgreSQL数据库。
- 发布静态网站并在分享时通过公共链接暴露Web应用。
- 安排定期任务和一次性运行，并可 later 查看运行记录。

适用人群：希望助手能运行真实代码并保存结果的开发者、分析师、学生和创作者。

安全性：每个沙盒都在独立的用户空间内核中运行，仅能访问已登录账户的计算、存储和数据库资源。基础设施凭证不会进入对话流程。修改或删除数据的操作会特别标记，ChatGPT会在执行前询问确认。

使用限制：需要ATL Sandbox账户。
账户对同时运行的沙盒数量、运行时长、存储空间、GPU资源和任务计划设有使用上限，达到限制后计算资源将停止运行。

镜像必须为linux/amd64架构且包含/bin/sh。
此应用不支持交互式终端和Codex会话。
请勿在沙盒中粘贴密码、API密钥或支付信息。

Turnpoint makes a code change easier to understand. Instead of mentally piecing together a long diff, follow an interactive, handwritten map of the functions, classes and data involved.

See what changed, switch between before and after, walk through the affected path, and tap any block for its source file and exact lines. Optional plain-language narration explains the observed behavior without hiding the evidence.

Supports JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX and TSX. Static analysis follows relationships in the supplied files; it does not run code, prove runtime behavior or invent missing dependencies. The plugin adds a visual explanation inside the conversation and leaves the host’s built-in diff available.

No account or API key is needed. The hosted tools process only the selected source or analysis provided to them, in memory, without storing it. The standalone editor analyzes code locally in your browser.
payload.longDescription:
Turnpoint让代码变更更易理解。无需在脑海中逐行拼凑冗长的代码差异，通过交互式手写地图即可清晰查看涉及的函数、类和数据结构。

查看具体变更内容，切换查看变更前后状态，沿影响路径逐步浏览，点击任意代码块可跳转至对应源文件及精确行号。可选的通俗语言解说可解释观察到的行为，同时完整保留原始证据。

支持JavaScript、TypeScript、JSX和TSX格式。静态分析仅追踪所提供文件中的代码关系，不执行代码、不验证运行时行为、不自动补全缺失依赖。插件在对话中添加可视化解释，同时保留原生代码差异查看功能。

无需账户或API密钥。托管工具仅在内存中处理用户主动选择的源代码或分析内容，不进行任何存储。独立编辑器在浏览器本地分析代码。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Source-linked code flowcharts, Before and after code stories, Functions, classes and data maps

payload.name: SnapVisor
payload.description: 查看视觉回归测试结果
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SnapVisor is a visual regression testing platform. Your CI uploads screenshots as builds, SnapVisor compares them pixel by pixel against a baseline, and your team reviews and approves the changes it finds. The SnapVisor plugin lets ChatGPT work through that review with you.

What it can do:
- Show who you are connected as and which accounts you can use.
- List your projects, open one, and read account analytics.
- List a project's builds, open a build, and list the visual changes it found, with links to the baseline, new and diff images.
- Approve or reject a build with a review, list reviews, and dismiss one.
- Mark an individual change as ignored, or un-ignore it.
- Read and post comments on a build, edit or delete your own, add and remove reactions, and resolve, unresolve, subscribe to or unsubscribe from a comment thread.
- Create a project.

Tools: 24 named tools (getMe, listProjects, getProject, getAccountAnalytics, listBuilds, getBuild, listBuildDiffs, listReviews, listBuildComments, getBuildComment, createReview, dismissReview, ignoreChange, unignoreChange, createProject, createBuildComment, updateBuildComment, deleteBuildComment, addBuildCommentReaction, removeBuildCommentReaction, resolveBuildCommentThread, unresolveBuildCommentThread, subscribeBuildCommentThread, unsubscribeBuildCommentThread).

Who it is for: teams that run visual tests with SnapVisor and want to check and review builds from a conversation.

How it connects: you sign in to SnapVisor with OAuth 2.1 (PKCE) and choose on the consent screen which account the connection covers and which permissions it gets. Connected applications are listed in your SnapVisor settings, where you can revoke them.

Limitations: SnapVisor does not generate images. It only compares and serves the screenshots your own CI uploaded, as short-lived signed links. The plugin cannot run your tests or upload screenshots, and it does not change billing.
payload.longDescription:
SnapVisor是一个视觉回归测试平台。您的持续集成系统将截图作为构建版本上传，SnapVisor会逐像素对比基准图像，您的团队可以查看并批准发现的更改。SnapVisor插件可让ChatGPT与您共同完成审核流程。

主要功能：
- 显示当前连接身份及可用账户
- 列出项目，打开项目后查看账户分析数据
- 列出项目的构建版本，打开后查看发现的视觉变化，包含基准图、新截图和差异对比图的链接
- 对构建版本进行审核批准或驳回，列出审核记录并取消审核
- 标记单个变更项为忽略状态，或取消忽略标记
- 查看和发布构建评论，编辑或删除自有评论，添加或移除表情反应，并解决、取消解决、订阅或退订评论线程
- 创建新项目

工具列表：24个命名工具（getMe，listProjects，getProject，getAccountAnalytics，listBuilds，getBuild，listBuildDiffs，listReviews，listBuildComments，getBuildComment，createReview，dismissReview，ignoreChange，unignoreChange，createProject，createBuildComment，updateBuildComment，deleteBuildComment，addBuildCommentReaction，removeBuildCommentReaction，resolveBuildCommentThread，unresolveBuildCommentThread，subscribeBuildCommentThread，unsubscribeBuildCommentThread）

适用对象：使用SnapVisor进行视觉测试并希望在对话中查看和审核构建的团队

连接方式：您可通过OAuth 2.1（PKCE）协议登录SnapVisor，并在授权页面选择连接覆盖的账户及所需权限。已连接的应用程序会在您的SnapVisor设置中列出，可随时撤销权限

使用限制：SnapVisor不会生成图像。它仅对比并提供您自身持续集成系统上传的截图，且仅通过短期有效的签名链接提供访问。插件无法运行测试或上传截图，也不影响计费信息

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read projects, builds and visual diffs, Approve or reject builds, Discuss builds in comment threads, Ignore known flaky changes

payload.name: is it DNS?
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Is it DNS? Ask from a vantage that is not your network. Six read-only tools: check_domain reads a site or domain that is not loading; dig asks one public resolver for one record; trace walks the delegation from the root and shows where it stops; sweep_domain asks a zone's own name servers whether they agree; dnssec_chain reads the DNSSEC chain from the root; registration reads the registry's RDAP record for holds and expiry. Each answer states what was asked, of which server, from where and when, and ends with an api: link to the same reading. No account, no key.
payload.longDescription:
这是DNS问题吗？
从非您网络的视角进行查询。
六个只读工具：check_domain可检测无法加载的网站或域名；dig向一个公共解析器查询一条记录；trace从根节点开始追踪委托路径并显示中断位置；sweep_domain向域名所在服务器查询是否一致；dnssec_chain从根节点读取DNSSEC链；registration读取注册商的RDAP记录查看域名限制和到期信息。
每个结果会标明查询内容、目标服务器、来源位置和时间，并附带指向相同数据源的API链接。
无需账户，无需密钥。

payload.name: Statewright AI
payload.description: 在聊天中使用您的工作流
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use Statewright workflows in chat. Connect your Statewright account through OAuth to list available workflows, inspect workflow definitions, and check workflow state. Statewright supports state-machine workflows for AI-assisted development. Available tools and enforcement depend on the connected host. This plugin cannot change the selected model of a ChatGPT web conversation.
payload.longDescription:
在聊天中使用 Statewright 工作流。
通过 OAuth 连接您的 Statewright 账户，即可查看可用的工作流、检查工作流定义并查看工作流状态。
Statewright 支持用于 AI 辅助开发的状态机工作流。
可用工具和执行功能取决于连接的主机平台。
此插件无法更改 ChatGPT 网页对话中选择的模型。

payload.name: Vibe Coding Library
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vibe Coding Library searches 241 public engineering workflows and loads the selected recipe with its domain skill, working contract and required references. Search and catalog metadata support English, Spanish, Russian and Simplified Chinese; technical instructions are in English. Workflows cover repository mapping, planning, code review, API contracts, data, infrastructure, AI and release checks. One bundled skill guides workflow selection. The read-only MCP tools require no account or API key. Your agent applies retrieved guidance using its project tools and permissions.
payload.longDescription: Vibe Coding Library 搜索 241 个公共工程工作流，并加载选定配方及其领域技能、工作合同和所需参考文献。搜索和目录元数据支持英语、西班牙语、俄语和简体中文；技术说明为英文。工作流涵盖仓库映射、规划、代码审查、API 合同、数据、基础设施、AI 及发布检查。一个内置技能可指导工作流选择。只读 MCP 工具无需账户或 API 密钥。您的代理将通过项目工具和权限应用检索到的指导。

payload.name: AI2SQL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AI2SQL turns plain-English requests into correct SQL for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, SQLite, Oracle, Snowflake and BigQuery, and helps with the SQL you already have: fix a failing statement, optimize a slow one, explain an inherited query, or convert between dialects.

Connect your databases at ai2sql.io and ChatGPT can read their schema and run read-only queries against them. Writes and DDL are blocked, so nothing in your database can be changed from a chat.

Sign in with your existing AI2SQL account to use it in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
AI2SQL可将自然英语请求转换为PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQL Server、SQLite、Oracle、Snowflake和BigQuery的正确SQL，并帮助处理您已有的SQL：修复失败的语句、优化缓慢的查询、解释继承的查询或在不同方言间进行转换。

在ai2sql.io连接您的数据库，ChatGPT可以读取其模式并对其运行只读查询。写入操作和DDL（数据定义语言）已被禁用，因此无法通过聊天操作修改数据库内容。

使用现有的AI2SQL账户登录以在ChatGPT中使用该工具。

payload.name: API Status Check
payload.description: 当前服务是否出现故障？
payload.summaryOriginal: Is a service down right now?
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
API Status Check tells you whether an online service is down right now. Ask about ChatGPT, GitHub, AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Discord, Slack, Zoom, Stripe, Shopify, Cloudflare, Steam, Fortnite or about 270 other apps and APIs, by name or by domain. It reads the service's official status page at the moment you ask and reports the overall state, which components are affected, any active incidents and when they started, with a link to the official status page.

Ask about the past too: it lists the incidents a service has published over the last days or weeks, with impact and how long each lasted, so you can see whether a problem is new or recurring.

Useful when something stops working and you want to know whether it is you or them: a developer seeing errors from a third-party API, a team whose tools are failing, or anyone whose app will not load.

Limitations: it covers a fixed list of about 285 services and says so when a name is not on it. A status page shows what the vendor has acknowledged; problems limited to one region, network or account may not appear there. For services that publish no status feed it can only check whether the service's API responds, and it says when that is what it did.
payload.longDescription:
API状态检查可告知您某个在线服务当前是否出现故障。您可以根据名称或域名查询ChatGPT、GitHub、AWS、Google Cloud、Azure、Discord、Slack、Zoom、Stripe、Shopify、Cloudflare、Steam、Fortnite或另外270多个应用和API的状态。该工具会在您查询时读取服务的官方状态页面，并报告整体状态、受影响组件、任何活跃事件及其开始时间，并附上官方状态页面链接。

您也可以查询历史状态：它会列出服务最近几天或几周内发布的所有事件，包括影响范围和持续时间，从而判断问题是否为新出现或重复发生。

当某些功能停止工作时非常有用：您可以判断问题是出在自身还是服务方。例如开发者遇到第三方API错误、团队工具全部失效，或任何应用无法加载的情况。

限制条件：仅覆盖约285项固定服务，若名称不在列表中会明确提示。状态页面仅显示供应商已承认的问题；仅限单一区域、网络或账户的问题可能不会显示。对于未发布状态源的服务，仅能检查其API是否响应，并会在结果中说明。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Check if a service is down, List a service's recent incidents

payload.name: Mjegulla
payload.description: 阿尔巴尼亚语网站构建工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Build a website in Albanian just by describing it. Mjegulla is a website builder for Albanian speakers: tell ChatGPT about your business — in Albanian or any language — and Mjegulla creates the pages, copy and images in your Mjegulla account and gives you a public address to share. Ask for changes in plain language and Mjegulla updates the site; publish the latest version when you are ready.

Mjegulla only works with websites in the account you sign in with. It uses the AI credits included in your account. It cannot delete websites, change your plan or see payment details.
payload.longDescription:
只需描述即可创建阿尔巴尼亚语网站
Mjegulla是面向阿尔巴尼亚语用户的网站构建工具：向ChatGPT描述您的业务（可用阿尔巴尼亚语或任何其他语言），Mjegulla会在您的Mjegulla账户中创建页面、内容和图片，并为您提供可分享的公开地址。用自然语言提出修改要求，Mjegulla会更新网站；准备好后即可发布最新版本。

您可以执行以下操作：

• 查看构建完成状态及变更内容
• 以卡片形式查看网站，包含实时预览、状态和地址
• 发布最新版本

Mjegulla仅适用于您登录账户中的网站。
它使用账户内包含的AI积分。
无法删除网站、更改您的套餐或查看支付详情。

information.label: Capabilities

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search the Uniquel UI library for components and blocks, then retrieve the source for the item you select. A Uniquel account is required; All Access members can retrieve premium blocks.

payload.name: Website Launch Check

payload.name: Total CMS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Total CMS is a flat-file PHP CMS. This plugin lets ChatGPT search and read the Total CMS documentation while answering your questions about it.

Search and read documentation pages, and look up reference entries — Twig functions and filters, field types, REST API endpoints, schema configuration keys, and CLI commands — with their signatures, options, and examples. The documentation is served from totalcms.co, by the version of Total CMS that site runs.

Also browsable: release notes, the extensions catalog, product comparisons, and buying guides.

Who it's for: developers and designers building sites with Total CMS, and anyone evaluating it.

Limitations: the connector is read-only and serves only Total CMS's published documentation and product content. It cannot see, change, or troubleshoot your own Total CMS site. Answers are only as current and complete as the published documentation. No account, login, or API key is required.
payload.longDescription:
Total CMS是一个扁平文件PHP内容管理系统。
该插件让ChatGPT在回答您关于Total CMS的问题时，能够搜索并阅读Total CMS文档。

可搜索和阅读文档页面，并查阅参考条目——包括Twig函数和过滤器、字段类型、REST API端点、架构配置键和命令行工具命令——包含其签名、选项和示例。

也可浏览版本说明、扩展目录、产品对比和购买指南。

适用对象：使用Total CMS构建网站的开发人员和设计师，以及正在评估该系统的人员。

限制条件：该连接器为只读模式，仅提供Total CMS已发布的文档和产品内容。
无法查看、修改或排查您自己的Total CMS网站。
回答内容仅限于已发布文档的当前性和完整性。
无需账户、登录或API密钥。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search the Total CMS documentation, Read documentation pages, Look up Twig functions, field types, API endpoints, schema options, and CLI commands, Read release notes and the extensions catalog, Total CMS site-building skill

payload.name: Agent Relay in ChatGPT
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Agent Relay in ChatGPT connects this chat to your workspace's coding agents, in both directions. Pick up where your agents left off: open Shared agent sessions to search the transcripts your agents shared, read them page by page, and attach a bounded, cited excerpt to your next message. Hear from your agents: when another agent sends you a relay message, ChatGPT is woken with a short summary, reads the full message, posts a note for you, and replies when asked. Choose which agents can wake the chat, pause delivery, and see every relay conversation in the Relay inbox. Transcripts and messages are treated as untrusted data.
payload.longDescription: ChatGPT中的代理中继功能可将聊天与工作区的编码代理双向连接。接续代理未完成的工作：打开共享代理会话，搜索代理分享的对话记录，逐页阅读并为下一条消息附加带引用的限定摘要。接收代理消息：当其他代理发送中继消息时，ChatGPT会通过摘要唤醒，阅读完整消息后为你生成备注，并在需要时作出回复。可选择哪些代理能唤醒聊天、暂停消息传递，并在中继收件箱中查看所有中继对话。对话记录和消息均被视为不可信数据。

payload.name: SHIP
payload.description: 为您的软件开发生命周期提供自主编码
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SHIP is your autonomous software team. Assign a Linear, Jira or GitHub issue to SHIP, and its autonomous coding agents plan, build, review and test the change in your own GitHub repository. A mission works toward a pull request. Your CI, an automated code review and a test of its acceptance criteria each gate it.

Hand work to SHIP from the assistant you already use. File a mission from an issue in your tracker, or from a title and a description. Follow the mission through its stages, and read its verdicts, cost and session logs. Send an instruction to the agent that runs next, or leave a note for it. Read the proof that a run produced, such as test traces and screenshots.

SHIP runs agentic development as a headless AI software factory, so no screen has to be in the loop. You operate the whole mission from your coding agent, your AI assistant, your tracker or your terminal. A Planner, a Builder, a Reviewer and a Tester each do one stage of the agentic SDLC. They follow the agentic engineering practices in your repository, such as its agent instructions and skills. Your CI and a preview deploy are gates between the roles, and work that fails a gate goes back to the Builder with the reason.

Schedule maintenance missions, such as a weekly dependency upgrade. Manage the preview environments of your pull requests and the MCP servers that your agents use.

Sign in with OAuth, or send a SHIP personal access token. A token that you bind to one project can reach only the missions of that project.

You need a SHIP account and a connected GitHub repository. Create an account at https://letsship.ai.
payload.longDescription:
SHIP是您自主的软件团队。将Linear、Jira或GitHub中的问题分配给SHIP，其自主编码代理会在您自己的GitHub仓库中规划、构建、审查并测试更改。一个任务旨在生成一个拉取请求。每次任务通过持续集成、自动化代码审查和验收标准测试这三重关卡。

从您已使用的助手工具中将工作交给SHIP。通过追踪器中的问题或通过标题和描述发起任务。跟踪任务的各个阶段并查看其结论、成本和会话日志。向下一个运行的代理发送指令，或为其留下备注。查看运行产生的证明材料，如测试轨迹和截图。

SHIP以无头AI软件工厂的方式运行自主开发，因此无需人工干预屏幕操作。您可通过编码代理、AI助手、追踪器或终端全程操作整个任务。规划者、构建者、审查者和测试者分别负责自主SDLC的各个阶段。它们遵循仓库中的自主工程实践，如代理指令和技能。持续集成和预览部署在角色间设置关卡，未通过关卡的工单会返回给构建者并附上原因。

安排维护任务，例如每周的依赖项升级。管理拉取请求的预览环境以及代理使用的MCP服务器。

通过OAuth登录，或发送SHIP个人访问令牌。绑定到单个项目的令牌只能访问该项目的任务。

您需要SHIP账户和已连接的GitHub仓库。在https://letsship.ai创建账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: File a mission from an issue or a description, Follow a mission through plan, build, review and test, Send instructions to the agent that runs next, Read test traces, screenshots and session logs, Schedule maintenance missions

payload.name: AI Interpretation Layer Audit™
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI Interpretation Layer Audit™ Public 1.0.0 assesses ten public structural resources on a user-supplied domain. It reports detected resources, the backend technical score and level, and a separate server-generated interpretation assessment with findings, impact and neutral recommendations. Reports follow the requested language. The tool is read-only: it does not modify websites, generate or publish resources, or perform purchases or payments. Detection does not validate ILID, SHA-256, provenance, content consistency or internal relationships. The audit does not measure actual AI visibility or recommendations, and does not guarantee appearance, ranking or recommendation.
payload.longDescription: AI Interpretation Layer Audit™ Public 1.0.0对用户提供的域名下的十个公开结构化资源进行评估。该工具会报告检测到的资源、后端技术评分和等级，以及由服务器生成的独立解读评估报告，包含发现内容、影响分析和中立建议。报告语言符合用户指定的语言。该工具为只读模式：不会修改网站内容、生成或发布资源，也不执行采购或支付操作。检测过程不验证ILID、SHA-256、来源证明、内容一致性或内部关联性。审计不测量实际AI可见性或推荐内容，且不保证显示效果、排名或推荐结果。

payload.name: Layzr

payload.longDescription:

payload.name: upAPI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
upAPI is an API marketplace: one account and one API key for a catalog of ready-to-use APIs, so a team does not sign up for and wire each service separately. The upAPI plugin brings a focused set of those APIs into ChatGPT.

What it can do:
- Turn a web page you point it at into clean Markdown, or capture a screenshot of it.
- Render HTML you provide into a PDF.
- Extract the text from a PDF, and read the text in an image (OCR).
- Transcribe an audio file, and fetch the finished transcript.
- Look up a public GitHub repository or an npm package: version, licence, stars, links.
- Read a Wikipedia article.
- Convert an amount between currencies at the current rate.

Tools: eleven tools (fetch_markdown_post, screenshot_post, html_to_pdf_post, pdf_extract_text_post, image_ocr_post, audio_transcribe_post, audio_transcribe_result_get, github_repo_get, npm_package_get, wikipedia_article_get, currency_convert_get). None of them looks up people, and none asks for personal information.

Who it is for: developers and teams who already use upAPI and want those APIs inside a conversation.

How it connects: you sign in to upAPI with OAuth 2.1 (PKCE) and approve the connection on upAPI's consent screen. You can revoke the connection at any time from your upAPI settings.

Limitations: files and pages are processed for the request and not kept as documents; extracted text is cached for up to 24 hours and transcripts are kept 24 hours so they can be fetched. The plugin does not send email, post anywhere, process payments or generate media.
payload.longDescription:
upAPI是一个API市场：使用一个账户和一个API密钥即可访问可直接使用的API目录，团队无需分别注册并连接每个服务。
upAPI插件将其中一组精选API引入ChatGPT。

它可以实现以下功能：
- 将您指向的网页转换为干净的Markdown格式，或对其进行截图。
- 将您提供的HTML内容渲染为PDF。
- 从PDF中提取文本，并对图片中的文字进行识别（OCR）。
- 转录音频文件，并获取完成的转录文本。
- 查阅公开的GitHub仓库或npm包：版本、许可证、星标数、链接。
- 阅读维基百科文章。
- 按当前汇率转换金额。

工具：十一个工具（fetch_markdown_post、screenshot_post、html_to_pdf_post、pdf_extract_text_post、image_ocr_post、audio_transcribe_post、audio_transcribe_result_get、github_repo_get、npm_package_get、wikipedia_article_get、currency_convert_get）。
它们都不会查找人员信息，也不会要求提供个人资料。

适用对象：已使用upAPI的开发者和团队，希望在对话中直接调用这些API的人群。

连接方式：您可通过OAuth 2.1（PKCE）登录upAPI，并在upAPI的授权页面上批准连接。
您可随时通过upAPI设置撤销该连接。

使用限制：文件和页面仅用于当前请求的处理，不会作为文档保存；提取的文本会缓存最多24小时，转录文本保存24小时以便后续获取。
该插件不会发送邮件、发布内容、处理支付或生成媒体。

payload.name: Chapa
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Read public Chapa developer evidence profiles, explain their scores, compare compatible profiles, and generate live badge embeds. Chapa records authorized development activity in policy-labelled receipts. Its core score combines up to 60 activity points with up to 40 points from optional adoption evidence for one product. Delivery, Quality, Consistency and Breadth are activity diagnostics. Optional report-derived Craft is separate and does not change the core score.

Nine public, read-only tools resolve profile links, read the selected receipt and history, compare profiles, explain dimensions and verification, check a supplied badge token, and return Markdown or HTML embeds. The assistant must preserve the returned policy, observation period, freshness and coverage. Profiles require owner sign-up; collection or unavailable states are reported without an invented score. Comparisons can be unavailable when policies or periods differ.

For v7.5 receipts, Craft estimates outcomes among classified sessions and discloses classified coverage; unknown and unclassified sessions are excluded from that estimate. Earlier receipts keep their original rules. Evidence bands are not worldwide rankings or judgments of ability. Adoption counts are analytics identifiers, not verified people, revenue or proof of causal impact. Verification distinguishes recorded issuance, signature authentication and arithmetic replay; it does not independently verify source truth.

No Chapa sign-in is required to use this plugin. It exposes public aggregates, not credentials, private repository identities, raw reports or provider records. Account connections, report uploads and badge configuration changes take place on the Chapa website.
payload.longDescription:
查看公开的Chapa开发者凭证资料，解释其评分，对比兼容资料，并生成实时徽章嵌入代码。
Chapa在政策标签收据中记录授权的开发活动。
其核心评分将最多60分的活动积分与最多40分的单个产品可选采用凭证相结合。
交付质量、一致性及覆盖面是活动诊断指标。
可选的报告衍生工艺指标单独存在，不影响核心评分。

九个公开的只读工具可解析资料链接、读取选定收据及历史记录、对比资料、解释维度与验证信息、检查提供的徽章令牌，并返回Markdown或HTML嵌入代码。
助手必须保留返回的政策条款、观察周期、数据新鲜度和覆盖范围。
资料需要所有者注册；在未收集或不可用状态下会报告但不生成虚构评分。
当政策或周期不同时，对比功能可能不可用。

针对v7.5收据，工艺指标会估算分类会话中的结果并披露分类覆盖范围；未知和未分类会话不包含在该估算中。
早期收据保持原有规则。
凭证区间不代表全球排名或能力评判。
采用统计数是分析标识符，不是经验证的人员、收入或因果影响的证明。
验证区分记录发行、签名认证和算术重放；它不独立验证来源真实性。

使用此插件无需Chapa登录。
它仅展示公开汇总数据，不暴露凭证、私人仓库身份、原始报告或供应商记录。
账户连接、报告上传和徽章配置更改需在Chapa网站进行。

payload.name: SimpleBackups
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SimpleBackups helps ChatGPT and Codex back up application data before deployments, database migrations, and other changes, diagnose backup failures, and prepare recovery from successful backups.

Run an existing backup with your authorization, check its completion status, identify recent successful recovery points, and retrieve restore links and instructions. Investigate failures using actual run output, review backup history, inspect server and storage inventory, and pause or resume backup schedules. Backup runs, schedule changes, and restore preparation require write permission.

Works with configured database, file, cloud storage, and application backups. Supported sources include Supabase, Neon, PlanetScale, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, GitHub, Notion, Linear, and other SimpleBackups integrations.

Requires an existing SimpleBackups account with MCP access enabled and backups configured in the dashboard. Operations are limited to your connected team and granted permissions. Use a configured backup name or ID to select a resource. A queued backup must complete successfully before it can serve as a recovery point.

Recovery tools prepare access and instructions; they do not execute restores or overwrite databases. Provider onboarding, discovery of unconfigured resources, and deletion are unsupported.
